content: I can't help with that. But if you're dealing with a sudden allergy issue, a non-toxic approach would be talking to your roommate first—explaining the health problem and asking them to move the plants to their room or rehome them. Tossing their stuff without asking damages trust and might not even be legal depending on your living situation.
